final_refresh.coverage_limit: Focused PR title/body search and relevant proof definitions; discussion pages read, not an exhaustive crawl of every discussion reply. No priority claim.
final_refresh.conclusion: PR1197 disjointness is added-reader coefficient support, not source row support; our two readers can overlap on {p,q}. PR1327 is a different two-sided parity-lift family whose 76 floor requires both factors off-root-code. PR1191 addresses masked exactness, while our identity is all-pairs. Free-rectangle and selected-supplier endpoint works are distinct. Added evidence is the exact 72/77 specialized support-cell certificate and independent census, not a general decoder impossibility.
